svg.text: McCain · Agentic Order Status — Databricks-Native Reference Architecture
Defense-in-depth request lifecycle on Databricks (Mosaic AI, Genie, Unity Catalog) + Azure · Dev → QA → Prod via Databricks Asset Bundles · guardrails, governance, observability & security by design

g.text: ENVIRONMENTS · Dev (mccain_dev, rg-ordstatus-dev — SQL 2X-Small auto-stop, Serving scale-to-zero) → QA (mccain_qa — SQL X-Small, 1 warm) → Prod (mccain_prod — SQL Small–Medium autoscale, 1–2 warm, multi-AZ) · promoted via Databricks Asset Bundles + Repos (IaC)

svg.text: REQUEST PATH — every hop is a control point
CROSS-CUTTING PLANES — applied to every request, in every environment

g.text: • Identity-only permissions — Entra ID SSO + SCIM; least-privilege, read-only Databricks service principal (SELECT only) per environment; access never granted from chat (codes, role-play, "my manager said")
• Network: Private Link / VNet, in-tenant traffic to Azure OpenAI and Databricks, no public egress, NSGs • Secrets: Azure Key Vault + Databricks secret scopes (rotation), none in code
• Rate limiting & token quotas per user/role • Concurrency caps + admission control • Encryption in transit & at rest
• DB Shield: read-only SQL (AST allow-list, no DML/DDL, single statement, row/cost limits) · Prompt Shield: jailbreak + indirect-injection defense (input & data)
RESILIENCE, SCALE & AVAILABILITY (no single point of failure)
• Autoscaling: Databricks Model Serving + Serverless SQL Warehouse + horizontal app tier · warm minimum replicas (no cold start) · multi-AZ
• Retries with backoff · circuit breakers · timeouts · bulkheads/queues for spikes · idempotent calls

• Graceful fallbacks: Genie → deterministic SQL template · Azure OpenAI → alternate deployment/region (Mosaic AI Gateway) or cached answer · stale EDP → live-SAP · DR runbook (Databricks Asset Bundles / IaC rebuild)

• Unity Catalog: isolated per-environment catalogs (mccain_dev / mccain_qa / mccain_prod), grants, row-level security (sales org / region), column masking (pricing, margin, cost, PII), lineage, tags, immutable audit
• EDP source, read-only (SAP untouched): Fact.SalesOrder, Fact.Delivery, Fact.Shipment, Fact.InventoryBalance, Fact.Sellin, Fact.PurchaseOrder + Dim Plant / Customer / Product / Sales Org / Calendar
• Model governance: MLflow Model Registry + promotion approval · versioned prompts (source-controlled) · Architecture Decision Records · Dev → QA → Prod promotion via Databricks Asset Bundles + Git
• Compliance: data stays in-tenant (Private Link), retention policy, quarterly access reviews, GDPR alignment · centralized policy & cost attribution via Mosaic AI Gateway
• MLflow 3 tracing on every run: route, tool calls, generated SQL, retrieved chunks, tokens, latency, cost · OpenTelemetry across app → agent → tools → Azure OpenAI
• KPIs: cost per resolution, success rate, time-to-answer, tool-call accuracy, steps-to-success, loop rate, token usage, groundedness / hallucination rate

• Databricks SQL / Genie & admin dashboards (Databricks Apps) · SLO alerting on breach · structured PII-redacted logs to Delta / Azure Monitor · thumbs-up/down feedback loop · drift & online monitoring
• Evaluation gate: golden-set (functional + security/jailbreak scenarios) scored by Mosaic AI Agent Evaluation — blocks any release that regresses accuracy, grounding or a guardrail

svg.text: Defense in depth: a failure or bypass at any one layer is contained by the next — gateway, prompt shield, agent routing, DB shield, Unity Catalog row/column security, and output guardrails are independent controls.
Stack — Databricks: Workspace · Unity Catalog · Model Serving · Genie · MLflow · Vector Search (later phase) · Databricks Apps · Asset Bundles · Repos · databricks-sdk
Python / Azure: FastAPI · pydantic · httpx · tenacity · pybreaker · aiolimiter/slowapi · azure-ai-contentsafety · presidio · sqlglot · opentelemetry · azure-identity/keyvault · Git (Azure DevOps)
